labelPolicy.target: Published visible-rooftop building polygons, not ground/base/facade, parcel/property, floors or surveyed building identity
labelPolicy.minimumStructure: Approximately5m2 with contextual exceptions under retained publisher guidance
labelPolicy.occlusion: Publisher may infer roof edges under trees/shadows; agent does not relabel or create uncertainty masks
labelPolicy.instances: Touching/shared/clipped structures retained;263 source features are not263 proven independent physical buildings
labelPolicy.rings: Original rings and full pixel vectors preserved;6 exterior rings extend beyond chip and rasterize only inside image;0 hole rings in selected data
labelPolicy.ignore: No publisher ignore or per-feature ambiguity mask; no TIFF NODATA tag or all-zero RGB pixels. Full-frame eligible-pixel mask is explicit publisher-label analysis policy, not official certainty.
